findings.issue: Idempotency is asserted only for the funnels path (backfillIsIdempotentAndNeverOverwritesExistingIds). The execution path has an additional idempotency contract per Decision 7: currentStepId is seeded ONLY when null and existing snapshot ids must not be overwritten. No test pins 'execution with a pre-existing currentStepId is left untouched'.
findings.suggestion: Add a test: insert an in-flight execution whose snapshot steps already have ids and whose currentStepId is already set to a value that differs from the index-derived one; run backfill; assert currentStepId is unchanged and ids are unchanged.

findings.issue: deepCopyButtonsAreIndependent proves list-reference isolation but does not assert the elements are the same immutable Button instances (shallow element copy is the intended Decision 5 behavior). Asserting element identity documents that Buttons are shared-by-reference (safe because immutable), preventing a future 'fix' that needlessly deep-copies records.
findings.suggestion: Add assertThat(copy.getButtons().get(0)).isSameAs(original.getButtons().get(0)) before mutating the lists, to pin the shallow-element-copy contract.
